notes: 2026-cycle filing, four pages: p1 = the county's new cover (TYPED, the '7 days before the candidates' convention' box marked X, signed 4-2-2026), p2 = Form A, p3 = Form B sheet 1 (all 11 entries), p4 = Form B sheet 2 (six empty printed rows plus the grand total alone). All three schedule pages are TRUE LANDSCAPE carrying /Rotate 270 - with Katrina Gibson's filing (/Rotate 90) these are the only rotated pages in this chunk, and they are the reason the shared make_snippet crop tool could not be used for verification here. FILER CORRECTION HONORED ON THE COVER: the Ending Balance cells were typed 1,995.76, then struck through and replaced with a handwritten slashed-zero initialled 'MT'; the corrected value (0) governs and the struck 1,995.76 is recorded, per the handwritten-correction rule. The cover's 'Last Report' column is entirely blank - this is the filer's first report of the cycle - which is why both sides reconcile as exact rather than period-exact. THE CAMPAIGN IS ENTIRELY SELF-FUNDED AND PASS-THROUGH: every one of the six Form A rows is a contribution from the candidate himself, and each matches a same-dated Form B payment to the cent (931.39 filing fee, 13.19 / 12.95 GoDaddy, 248.88 = 83.88 + 165.00 on 3-24, 339.99 signs, 449.36 = 139.43 + 134.29 + 15.01 + 10.63 + 150.00 on 4-1) - contributions and expenditures both total 1,995.76 and the balance is zero. NO TRANSACTION DATE ON EITHER SCHEDULE CARRIES A YEAR (the filer wrote 1-7, 3-17, 3-19, 3-24, 3-31, 4-1); every one is kept verbatim, flagged, and NO year was inferred from the report date. The county REDACTED the candidate's street address and city/zip on the cover AND the entire Address column of Form A, so all six donor city/state values are honestly blank as county-redacted. No in-kind item is labelled anywhere. Neither schedule prints a per-page subtotal.

2.measure_note: True LANDSCAPE page (/Rotate 270), so rows advance normally top-to-bottom: axis y. PART OF THIS GRID IS EXTRAPOLATED AND WAS PROVED. The COUNTY'S BLACK REDACTION BAR over the Address column spans roughly 17-36 pct of the page height and swallows every printed rule underneath it - the detector collapses the whole solid bar into ONE spurious 'rule' at its centre (26.53) and returns nothing else in that range. Below the bar the detector returns a clean run 39.26 / 42.44 / 45.59 / 48.85 / 51.94 / 55.12 / 58.35 / 61.56 / 64.79 / 68.00 / 71.18 / 74.32 / 77.47 / 80.65 / 83.85 / 87.09 / 90.38 at a constant ~3.19 pct pitch, and above it the header row ends at 13.76. Eight intervals fit exactly between 13.76 and 39.26 ((39.26-13.76)/8 = 3.1875), so the seven missing rules are 16.95 / 20.14 / 23.32 / 26.51 / 29.70 / 32.89 / 36.07 - and the fit is confirmed by the fact that the detected 39.26 lands 0.06 pct from the prediction. PROVED as the brief requires, with two crops at the first and last data row of the extrapolated span: row 2 reproduces 931.39 and row 7 reproduces 449.36. Row 1 is the grey shaded strip below the header; the filer's six entries are rows 2-7. Column bands measured with coverage restricted to the clean band below the bar (5.07 / 13.25 / 43.50 / 85.50 / 96.16). These schedule pages carry /Rotate 270, and scripts/campaign_finance/make_snippet.py maps pct->pixels with pdfinfo's UNROTATED MediaBox while pdftoppm's -x/-y/-W/-H address the ROTATED raster, so its --value crop lands in the wrong cell here. The bands below are in the frame the brief specifies - percentages of the page AS POPPLER RENDERS IT, rotation included - and were proved with raster crops taken directly from the rendered page. The shared script was left untouched and the defect is reported instead.
